description: Bovenlokaal Functioneel Fietsroutenetwerk is a dataset listed in transportdata.be, a national access point for transport data, published or maintained by Departement Mobiliteit en Openbare Werken. Het Vlaamse Fietsnetwerk wordt gevormd door het Bovenlokaal Functioneel Fietsroutenetwerk (BFF). Dit fietsroutenetwerk betreft een wensnetwerk: Bepaalde delen van het netwerk reeds zijn gerealiseerd, andere delen van dit netwerk dienen nog gerealiseerd te worden. Het BFF bestaat uit fietssnelwegen, hoofdroutes, functionele routes en alternatieve routes. Op dit netwerk sluiten ook lokale fietsroutes aan. Coverage: Belgium (see the dataset page for the exact area). The portal lists 1 resource in WMS_SRVC. The data standards named are other. The national access point types are MMTIS. The portal shows 2025-07-24 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support mobility and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-transportdata-be-national-access-point.
